🏫 Cafeteria Kitchen

Move: WASD / arrows.
Look: click then move the mouse.
Interact: click.

Grab ingredients and cook them on the three pans by the window. Then put it on the plate in front of the student, and tap them when their plate is ready. A shift lasts a few minutes and gets busier as it goes. Good luck!
